title: reseda phyteuma subsp. media
intro: Reseda phyteuma subsp. media, commonly known as the common mignonette or garden burnet, is a plant species in the family Resedaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of R. phyteuma subsp. media include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as fever, bronchitis, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of R. phyteuma subsp. media include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
